"This is a description of the horizontal bar chart provided in the first image.

### **Chart Title: Factors of Monetary Base Growth**
**Subtitle/Units:** (Trillions of AR$, Dec 11- May 23)

The chart illustrates the various components contributing to the growth of the monetary base. Values to the right of the zero line indicate factors that increased the monetary base, while values to the left indicate factors that decreased it.

| Factor | Estimated Value (Trillions of AR$) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Total (Dark Blue Bar)** | **~4.5** |
| Interest payments | ~11.5 |
| FX purchases | 10.0 |
| Net credit to gov't 1/ | ~0.5 |
| Peso-den. securities and other BCRA liabilities | ~-9.0 |
| BOPREAL | ~-8.5 |

**Note on Calculations:** The "Total" bar (approximately 4.5 trillion AR$) represents the net result of the positive drivers (Interest payments, FX purchases, and Net credit to gov't) minus the contractionary factors (BCRA liabilities and BOPREAL).

---
**Sources:** BCRA; and Fund staff calculations.
**Footnotes:** 1/ Includes put exercise, new NTTS and treasury buybacks."
